title: Find the mistake: requests and commands
instructions: Each sentence has **one** mistake – or no mistake at all. Find the wrong word and write the correct sentence.

items.sentence: Mrs Moreno told Mila tidy her room.
items.answer: Mrs Moreno told Mila to tidy her room.

items.sentence: Diego told Sofia don't touch his laptop.
items.answer: Diego told Sofia not to touch his laptop.

items.sentence: Coach Brooks said the team to warm up.
items.answer: Coach Brooks told the team to warm up.

items.sentence: Mila asked Tyler to wait for her.
items.hint: ask + person + to + infinitive – is everything there?

items.sentence: Mr Okafor told Mila to coming to his office.
items.answer: Mr Okafor told Mila to come to his office.

items.sentence: Ms Kim told the students to switch off their phones.
items.hint: tell + person + to + infinitive – is everything there?
